name: MEA 91st Annual Meetings
deadline_note: Abstract deadline extended from October 15 to October 25, 2026. Organized session proposals due November 1, 2026; undergraduate proposals December 1, 2026. Late submissions (USD 25 late fee) are wait-listed and reviewed in mid-February; no papers accepted after December 1, 2026.
submission_requirements: One-page abstract (PDF) with name, affiliation, title, co-authors, two JEL codes and three keywords, via Oxford Abstracts (separate forms for graduate students and professionals); members may submit a second, substantially different paper
submission_fee: USD 40 professionals / USD 35 graduate students / USD 20 undergraduates, plus annual MEA membership (USD 40 professionals / USD 30 graduate students) paid at submission
registration_fee: USD 185 professionals (members) / USD 235 non-members / USD 75 graduate students / USD 50 undergraduates; USD 50 late fee after deadline
membership_required: MEA membership is required for abstract submissions; presenters must register by February 15, 2027 or their papers are removed from the program
